answer: Require every agent to keep a signed work log, each entry stamped with a quill of sequential hashes of graded tasks, and raise the next-entry fee in a spiral as more new accounts share the same resource fingerprint. A sybil farm minting hundreds of clones soon hits a cost ridge where each fake must buy expensive unique compute history before its vote counts, so the attacker pays real capital per head and loses it all if any clone recycles fingerprints.
